adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, bookingCalendarReference was changed to an array (filter) and is iterated with `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. The recurring-cancellation branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`) is now inside that per-reference loop, so for multi-reference bookings it will re-run the `Promise.all(promises)` deletion sweep once per reference, duplicating deletions and increasing 404/410/rate-limit risk. Additionally, that branch still builds `promises` from `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith('_calendar'))`, not from the specific `reference.credentialId`, so it does not target “each reference’s credential” as the finding states.
